title: After disconnecting from an expanded VPN: the network item below expands and the configure button overlays content
line: Disconnecting an expanded VPN no longer makes the network that takes its place in the list show up expanded.
explanation: The Networks widget keeps the expanded state on the list delegate, not on the connection. When a connection changes state the proxy model re-sorts, and the list keeps its delegates in place and only swaps their data, so the delegate that was showing the expanded VPN starts showing the network that moved into that row (HomeNet), still expanded with its details. The connection item now collapses itself when the connection it shows (its Uni) changes, so an expanded state never moves to another connection.

commits.message:
applet: collapse a connection item when it starts showing another connection

The list reorders by changing the data of existing delegates, so after
disconnecting an expanded VPN the connection that moved into its place
showed up expanded. Collapse the item when its connection changes.

BUG: 490504

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in plasma-nm's ConnectionItem.qml that tracks model.Uni and collapses an expanded delegate whenever the proxy model reorders rows in place and assigns a different connection to that delegate. Collapsing on identity change prevents the next network in the list from appearing expanded after disconnecting an expanded VPN while keeping an expanded item open when unrelated items reorder around it. Before/after screenshots and videos clearly prove the fix and honestly note that the older 6.1 button-overlap artifact no longer reproduces on master.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in plasma-nm's ConnectionItem.qml that tracks model.Uni and collapses an expanded delegate whenever the proxy model reorders rows in place and assigns a different connection to that delegate. Collapsing on identity change prevents the next network in the list from appearing expanded after disconnecting an expanded VPN while keeping an expanded item open when unrelated items reorder around it. Before/after screenshots and videos clearly prove the fix and honestly note that the older 6.1 button-overlap artifact no longer reproduces on master.

This is the real cause: the sorted proxy model reorders by swapping data on existing ConnectionItem delegates, and the expanded state lives on the delegate. Collapsing when the delegate's Uni changes is a small, safe fix at the right level, it can't fire on creation, and it doesn't affect the password flow because DelayModelUpdates holds that item's data. The before-2/after-2 shots and the regression check (expanded Wired stays expanded across a re-sort) show it clearly. The overlapping Configure button from 2024 doesn't happen on master. Nitpick: Uni includes the device path, so an expanded item may also collapse when its own device association changes, which is harmless.
